name: Santa Olalla del Cala (Spain)
description: Quartered white and red at the top and green and white at the bottom, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Santa Olalla del Cala (a castle and a tree above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Santa Olalla del Cala; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Santa Olalla del Cala arms — castle and tree above waves
castle and crown of the arms
